blockingFindings: Windows cancellation can emit cancelled before confirming the root child has closed: observeTermination schedules a settle failure but completeCancelledReview immediately calls cancellation.complete(), cancelling that timer. A late tree-termination or child-close failure can therefore be reported after cancelled, violating fail-closed cancellation and risking persistence ordering.
missingNegativeTests: Add a regression test proving cancellation remains unresolved until both taskkill success and root-child close, and emits failed rather than cancelled when either confirmation fails late.

architectureAssessment.deepModules: Review binding, parsing, persistence, and cancellation helpers are separated, but cancellation remains orchestration-heavy.
architectureAssessment.hexagonalArchitecture: Provider selection and child execution remain bounded behind launcher interfaces without widening authority.
architectureAssessment.eventedBoundaries: Structured progress events exist, but Windows cancellation does not yet provide a reliable terminal event boundary.

exactNextAction: Revise Windows cancellation completion to await successful tree termination and root-child close or bounded failure, add the late-failure regression test, and rerun all packet-required checks.
